programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

From hilariously wrong answers to Steve Harvey's one-of-a kind reactions, "Family Feud Favorites" captures the best moments that fans can't stop talking about.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

After Vint's kids from a previous marriage leave the house, Mama's delinquent grandson Bubba is ordered to live with his grandmother after being released from juvenile hall and placed on probation. Iola Boylen, Thelma's friend and neighbor, is a frequent visitor to the Harper household, which is often the site of bickering between abrasive Mama and her loved ones. Vicki Lawrence stars as Mama, a character she originated in sketches on "The Carol Burnett Show."

programme.title: Newlyweds
programme.desc: After getting set up on a blind date through a mutual friend, Jeanie, a free-spirited social butterfly, and James, a divorced, buttoned-up professor, are surprised to learn they have great chemistry despite being total opposites. Their whirlwind courtship leads to James returning home early from an extended work trip abroad to be with Jeanie. Despite the chaos of meeting their respective loved ones, including James' opinionated ex-wife Claudia, they shock everyone by skipping the dating stage and deciding to get married. Now, they'll navigate this new normal together as they figure out what a love story looks like later in life.

programme.title: St. Denis Medical
programme.desc: Devoted nurse Alex has just been promoted to Supervising Nurse in the emergency department at St. Denis Medical Center in Oregon. She works alongside an eclectic team of underfunded yet dedicated doctors, nurses and hospital staff, including her boss, Joyce, who wants nothing more than to turn the hospital into an international medical destination, and Dr. Ron, who's done it all, seen it all and is pretty much over it all. They're all doing their best not to lose their patience in a hospital overrun with patients - while caring for everyone who comes in the door, including each other.

programme.title: Megan Leavey
programme.desc: The true life story of Megan Leavey, a young Marine corporal whose unique discipline and bond with a military combat dog saved many lives during her deployment in Iraq. Assigned to clean up the K-9 unit after a disciplinary hearing, Leavey starts to identify with Rex, a particularly aggressive dog that she trains. Over the course of their service, Megan and Rex complete more than 100 missions until an improvised explosive device injures both, putting their fates in jeopardy.

programme.title: Ocean's 11
programme.desc: Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies -- including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) -- to pull off an elaborate New Year's Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money.

programme.title: Ocean's Eleven
programme.desc: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history.

programme.title: Ocean's Twelve
programme.desc: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe.

programme.title: Ocean's Thirteen
programme.desc: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties.

programme.title: A Good Day to Die Hard
programme.desc: New York City cop John McClane (Bruce Willis) arrives in Moscow to track down his estranged son, Jack (Jai Courtney). McClane thinks his son is a criminal, so it comes as a shock when he learns that Jack is actually working undercover to protect Komarov (Sebastian Koch), a Russian government whistleblower. With their own lives on the line, McClane and Jack must overcome their differences in order to get Komarov to safety and thwart a potentially disastrous crime in the Chernobyl region.

programme.title: Pacific Rim Uprising
programme.desc: Jake Pentecost is a once-promising Jaeger pilot whose legendary father gave his life to secure humanity's victory against the monstrous Kaiju. Jake has since abandoned his training only to become caught up in a criminal underworld. But when an even more unstoppable threat is unleashed to tear through cities and bring the world to its knees, Jake is given one last chance by his estranged sister, Mako Mori, to live up to his father's legacy.

programme.title: Open Water
programme.desc: Daniel (Daniel Travis) and Susan (Blanchard Ryan) embark on a tropical vacation with their scuba-diving certifications in tow. During a group dive, the two separate themselves from the others to dive a little deeper. An incorrect head-count suggests the entire group has returned, so the boat departs. When the pair surfaces, they make out a vessel in the distance, but it does not immediately set in that they have been left behind. With sharks lurking beneath, their survival chances grow smaller.

programme.title: Meg 2: The Trench
programme.desc: Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. Their voyage spirals into chaos when a malevolent mining operation threatens their mission and forces them into a high-stakes battle for survival. Pitted against colossal, prehistoric sharks and relentless environmental plunderers, they must outrun, outsmart and outswim their merciless predators.

programme.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
programme.desc: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race.

programme.title: Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga
programme.desc: Young Furiosa gets caught in the crossfire of two tyrannical warlords. As the tyrants fight for dominance, Furiosa soon finds herself in a nonstop battle to make her way home.

programme.title: Catfish
programme.desc: When Nev Shulman, a New York photographer, receives a Facebook request from a child named Abby, he cannot guess the unusual odyssey on which he will soon embark. Abby sends Nev an unusually skilled painting based on one of his photos. Intrigued, he begins online relationships with the rest of Abby's family, including her older sister, Megan. Though troubling inconsistencies soon emerge, Nev continues his online flirtation with Megan, resulting in a road trip to meet her in person.

programme.title: Shut In
programme.desc: Mary Portman is a widowed child psychologist who lives in isolation in rural Maine. The horrific car accident that killed her husband also left her 18-year-old stepson Stephen in a bedridden, catatonic state, leaving him completely dependent on her. When one of Portman's young patients vanishes without a trace, she becomes convinced that the boy's ghost is now in the house as a dangerous ice storm starts to wreak havoc outside.

programme.title: It
programme.desc: In 1960, seven preteen outcasts fight an evil demon that poses as a child-killing clown. Thirty years later, they reunite to stop the demon once and for all when it returns to their hometown.

programme.title: Enemy
programme.desc: A mild-mannered college professor (Jake Gyllenhaal) discovers a look-alike actor and delves into the other man's private affairs.

programme.title: The Sessions
programme.desc: Though a childhood bout with polio left him dependent on an iron lung, Mark O'Brien (John Hawkes) maintains a career as a journalist and poet. A writing assignment dealing with sex and the disabled piques Mark's curiosity, and he decides to investigate the possibility of experiencing sex himself. When his overtures toward a caregiver (Annika Marks) scare her away, he books an appointment with sex surrogate Cheryl Cohen Green (Helen Hunt) to lose his virginity.

programme.title: William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet
programme.desc: Baz Luhrmann helped adapt this classic Shakespearean romantic tragedy for the screen, updating the setting to a post-modern city named Verona Beach. In this version, the Capulets and the Montagues are two rival gangs. Juliet is attending a costume ball thrown by her parents. Her father Fulgencio Capulet has arranged her marriage to the boorish Paris as part of a strategic investment plan. Romeo attends the masked ball and he and Juliet fall in love.

programme.title: Won't Back Down
programme.desc: Jamie Fitzpatrick and Nona Alberts are two women from opposite sides of the social and economic track, but they have one thing in common: a mission to fix their community's broken school and ensure a bright future for their children. The two women refuse to let any obstacles stand in their way as they battle a bureaucracy that's hopelessly mired in traditional thinking, and they seek to re-energize a faculty that has lost its passion for teaching.

programme.title: The Adjustment Bureau
programme.desc: Just as he is on the brink of winning a Senate seat, politician David Norris meets a ballerina named Elise Sellas. Though David is instantly smitten, mysterious men conspire to keep him away from the beautiful dancer. David learns that he is facing the powerful agents of Fate itself, and glimpsing the future laid out for him, must either accept a predetermined path that does not include Elise or else defy Fate to be with her.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
programme.desc: When Austria's crown prince is found dead, evidence seems to point to suicide. However, detective Sherlock Holmes deduces that the prince was murdered and that the crime is but a piece of a puzzle designed by an evil genius named Moriarty. Holmes and his friend Dr. Watson, who are accompanied by a Gypsy whose life Holmes saved, chase Moriarty across Europe in the hope that they can thwart his plot before it can come to fruition.

programme.title: Us
programme.desc: Accompanied by her husband, son and daughter, Adelaide Wilson returns to the beachfront home where she grew up as a child. Haunted by a traumatic experience from the past, Adelaide grows increasingly concerned that something bad is going to happen. Her worst fears soon become a reality when four masked strangers descend upon the house, forcing the Wilsons into a fight for survival. When the masks come off, the family is horrified to learn that each attacker takes the appearance of one of them.

programme.title: The Nun
programme.desc: When a young nun at a cloistered abbey in Romania takes her own life, a priest with a haunted past and a novitiate on the threshold of her final vows are sent by the Vatican to investigate. Together, they uncover the order's unholy secret. Risking not only their lives but their faith and their very souls, they confront a malevolent force in the form of a demonic nun.

programme.title: The Nun II
programme.desc: An evil spreads in 1956 France as a priest is murdered, and Sister Irene once again comes face-to-face with the demonic nun Valak.

programme.title: On Becoming a Guinea Fowl
programme.desc: On an empty road in the middle of the night, Shula stumbles across the body of her uncle. As the funeral unfolds, the cousins unveil the buried secrets of their Zambian family in a vibrant reckoning with the lies we tell ourselves.

programme.title: 3 Days to Kill
programme.desc: Facing a terminal disease, spy Ethan Renner (Kevin Costner) has decided to give up his dangerous, high-stakes life in order to rebuild his relationship with his estranged wife and daughter (Hailee Steinfeld), whom he previously pushed away to keep them out of harm's way. However, in exchange for a potentially lifesaving drug, he must complete one final mission: apprehend one of the world's most ruthless terrorists while looking after his teenage offspring in her mother's absence.

programme.title: Moonshot
programme.desc: Dans un futur où Mars est habitée, deux étudiants très différents se faufilent à bord d'une navette spatiale pour s'y rendre.

programme.title: Passagers
programme.desc: Jim Preston, mécanicien à bord d'un vaisseau spatial lancé dans un voyage de 120 années vers une planète lointaine, est réveillé 100 ans trop tôt suite à un bogue de l'ordinateur. Après une année à vivre seul entouré de robots et d'androïdes, il décide de réveiller un autre passager, la journaliste Aurora.

programme.title: La forme de l'eau
programme.desc: Elisa Esposito est muette. Elle travaille dans un laboratoire secret du gouvernement comme concierge. Elle mène une existence routinière et sans histoire jusqu'à ce qu'elle découvre l'existence d'une créature amphibie cachée dans l'un des bassins de l'établissement.

programme.title: 12 singes
programme.desc: Nous sommes en l'an 2035. Les quelques milliers d'habitants qui restent sur notre planète sont contraints de vivre sous terre. La surface du globe est devenue inhabitable à la suite d'un virus ayant décimé 99% de la population. Les survivants mettent tous leurs espoirs dans un voyage à travers le temps pour découvrir les causes de la catastrophe et la prévenir.

programme.title: Les patrouilleurs de l'espace
programme.desc: Au XXIVe siècle, une fédération musclée fait régner sur Terre l'ordre et la vertu, exhortant sans relâche la jeunesse à la lutte, au devoir, à l'abnégation et au sacrifice de soi. Mais aux confins de la galaxie, une armée d'arachnides se dresse contre l'espèce humaine et ces insectes géants rasent en quelques secondes la ville de Buenos Aires. Cinq jeunes gens volontaires partent en mission dans l'espace pour combattre les envahisseurs.

programme.title: L'homme sans ombre
programme.desc: Un biochimiste essaie sa formule d'invisibilité sur lui-même et apprend qu'aucun retour en arrière n'est possible.

programme.title: Le destructeur
programme.desc: En 2032, un policier et un psychopathe meurtrier s'affrontent à Los Angeles après avoir passé 36 ans dans un état d'hibernation artificielle.

programme.title: Le sixième jour
programme.desc: Alors que son propre clone a pris sa place dans sa maison, un homme doit échapper aux responsables de cette situation qui veulent protéger leur secret.

programme.title: Code source
programme.desc: Un militaire est projeté virtuellement, à répétition, dans un train de banlieue à huit minutes d'exploser, afin d'identifier le terroriste qui a posé la bombe.

programme.title: Paranoïa
programme.desc: Pris en flagrant délit de fraude par son employeur qui venait de le congédier injustement, un informaticien ambitieux doit choisir entre aller en prison ou infiltrer, en tant qu'espion, la firme du mentor et ancien associé de son patron.

programme.title: Mystères de famille: passé enfoui
programme.desc: Lorsque Jonathan, un ami proche de Sophie, doit trouver d'urgence un donneur de moelle osseuse, l'affaire devient personnelle.

programme.title: Gwen Shamblin: affamée de rédemption
programme.desc: Gwen Shamblin fonde un programme de régime amaigrissant basé sur le christianisme, prônant le pouvoir de la prière pour la perte de poids.

programme.title: Votez Bougon
programme.desc: Paul Bougon enflamme les réseaux sociaux et l'opinion publique après sa brève participation à une émission télévisée. Devenu une célébrité instantanée grâce à son franc-parler, il décide de se lancer en politique et fonde son propre parti. Avec l'aide de son entourage dévoué et à la tête du Parti de l'écoeurement national, il gagne les élections et obtient le poste de premier ministre. Les défis de sa nouvelle carrière le placent devant des choix déchirants.

programme.title: Un automne à Manhattan
programme.desc: Une femme optimiste et son voisin blasé découvrent ensemble la beauté de la ville de New York.

programme.title: L'amour à 16 ans
programme.desc: La journée d'anniversaire d'une adolescente de 16 ans qui est amoureuse du garçon le plus populaire de l'école et est aimée du garçon le moins en vue. Avec ses parents qui oublient son anniversaire, des grands-parents envahissants et un étudiant étranger sur les bras, tout est fait pour que cette journée soit inoubliable.

programme.title: 10 choses que je déteste de toi
programme.desc: Bianca Stratford doit fréquenter le collège de Padoue sans pouvoir se faire un petit ami. Les règles à la maison des Stratford ne lui permettent pas d'avoir un petit ami avant que son odieuse sœur qui est sèche et rude avec les garçons en ait un.

programme.title: Le dernier pub avant la fin du monde
programme.desc: Gary convainc ses amis, qui ont maintenant une vie bien rangée, de faire la même tournée des pubs qu'ils ont faite il y a 20 ans. Andy, Oliver, Steven et Peter se réunissent donc afin de rejoindre The World's End, un pub. Au cours de la soirée, ils réalisent que les villageois ont été remplacés par des automates qui menacent toute l'humanité.

programme.title: Jouer avec le feu
programme.desc: Lorsque le chef des pompiers, Jake Carson, et son équipe d'élite se portent à la rescousse de trois frères et sœurs, ils se rendent vite compte qu'aucune formation ne pourrait les préparer au travail le plus difficile à ce jour : la garde d'enfants. Alors que leur vie et leur emploi sont bouleversés, les trois hommes apprennent vite que les enfants, à l'instar des incendies, sont sauvages et imprévisibles.

programme.title: La gloire des ondes
programme.desc: Bien qu'elle soit jeune, jolie, dynamique et ambitieuse, Becky Fuller est en pleine traversée du désert professionnelle et sentimentale. Aussi, lorsqu'on propose à cette productrice de reprendre "Daybreak" la matinale la moins regardée du pays, elle accepte le défi sans hésiter. Pour augmenter l'audience, elle décide d'engager Mike Pomeroy, le journaliste de légende de la chaîne.

programme.title: La famille Stone
programme.desc: On fête Noël chez les Stone, famille fantasque et bohème, et c'est l'occasion pour le fils préféré de présenter sa nouvelle petite amie plutôt coincée.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: Quand une série de meurtres cruels terrorise Londres, il ne faut pas longtemps pour le légendaire détective Sherlock Holmes et son partenaire d'enquêtes le Dr Watson pour trouver le tueur, Lord Blackwood. Adepte des forces du mal, Blackwood a un projet plus important en tête.

programme.title: Le voeu
programme.desc: À la suite d'un accident de voiture, une jeune mariée sombre dans le coma pendant que son mari veille sur elle. Lorsqu'elle émerge et ne se souvient ni de lui ni de leur mariage, il tente de conquérir son cœur à nouveau.

programme.title: Passion
programme.desc: Isabelle est fascinée par sa supérieure, Christine. Cette dernière profite de son ascendant sur Isabelle pour l'entraîner dans un jeu de séduction.

programme.title: Vol sous haute pression
programme.desc: Un passager dans un avion force sa voisine à participer à un complot qui vise à assassiner un haut fonctionnaire gouvernemental.

programme.title: Ados sans limites
programme.desc: Une mère célibataire est heureuse que sa fille se fasse des amis à l'école. Elle apprend bientôt qu'ils suivent un code moral dangereux.

programme.title: La carte des étoiles
programme.desc: Benjie est un enfant vedette insupportable, qui se croit tout permis. Son père est un psychologue pour célébrités et sa sœur Agatha, une psychopathe, qui, après avoir tenté de mettre le feu à leur maison, a été reniée par sa famille. Exilée pendant de nombreuses années, Agatha, couverte de brûlures cicatrisées, revient à Los Angeles où elle s'éprend d'un chauffeur de limousine qui tente de percer à Hollywood.

programme.title: Pour l'amour de la musique
programme.desc: Une adaptation de la vie du trompettiste de jazz Chet Baker dans les années 60. Lorsque Chet joue dans un film dont il est le sujet, une romance se dessine avec sa protagoniste, Jane. Mais la production est mise de côté lorsque le passé vient hanter Chet et qu'il apprend qu'il ne pourra peut-être jamais plus jouer de la musique.

programme.desc: "Beyond the Gates" is set in a leafy Maryland suburb just outside of Washington D.C., and in one the most affluent African American counties in the United States. At the center of this community are the Duprees, a powerful and prestigious multi-generational family that is the very definition of Black royalty. But behind these pristine walls and lush, manicured gardens are juicy secrets and scandals waiting to be uncovered. And those that live outside these gates are watching closely. These are the places where the characters live, love, work and play. Those who have "made it" and those who haven't are all trying to navigate life - and some with more grace than others.

Tout en consultant un psychiatre, Valentini signe involontairement un engagement volontaire de 24 heures au centre Highland Creek. Son séjour à l'établissement se prolonge bientôt alors que les médecins et infirmières se questionnent sur sa santé mentale. Sawyer croit qu'un des employés est son harceleur — elle fera tout pour rester en vie et se sortir de là.

programme.title: Angoisse

programme.title: L'aube des survivants

Edward, un vampire hématologue essaie de créer un sang de substitution quand il rencontre Lionel et Audrey, deux humains fugitifs qui prétendent avoir un prétendu remède au vampirisme. Edward s'unit à Lionel et Audrey dans l'espoir d'améliorer le remède avant qu'il ne soit trop tard.

programme.title: Les sévices de Dracula

Un soir de messe noire, le comte Karnstein organise le sacrifice d'une vierge dans son château, ce qui réveillera son ancêtre, qui le transforme à son tour en vampire.

programme.title: The Verdict With Judge Hatchett
programme.desc: Judge Glenda Hatchett presided over her self-titled courtroom show from 2000-2008. Now, she returns to the medium with "The Verdict." In the half-hour series, the Atlanta native and former juvenile-court judge rules over small-claims cases brought in front of her. Hatchett's courtroom isn't just about finding someone guilty, though. She also uses her experience dealing with young people and her tough-love approach to help send a message to out-of-control juvenile offenders to try to set them on the right track in their lives.

programme.title: Live: Hot Stove
programme.desc: Baby, it might be cold outside, and the springtime sounds of bats hitting balls are months away. What better way for baseball fans to cure the winter blues than to gather around the "Hot Stove" and warm up to the news of the offseason? MLB Network has all the angles covered for all 30 teams, from trades and free agent signings to the juicy rumors that percolate throughout, especially at the annual Winter Meetings in December. programme.title: Just for Laughs: All Access
programme.desc: Shot on location at Montreal's acclaimed Just for Laughs Festival, each hourlong episode showcases performances from some of the biggest names in comedy. Canadian and international comics - up-and-coming talents as well as established artists - come together every July at the festival, including Jeff Foxworthy, Tim Allen, John Cleese, Billy Connolly, Gabriel Iglesias, Ilana Glazer, Andy Samberg, David Spade, Sandra Battaglini, Russell Peters, and Jay Pharoah, all of whom have taken the stage over the festival's decades-long history.

programme.title: The Guild Garage
programme.desc: In a multibillion dollar industry, the Guild of Automotive Restorers tries to get a piece of the pie by completing any task put before it. Through preservation, restoration and selling some of the world's greatest cars, the team at the Guild has gained an internationally acknowledged reputation. Owner David Granger and his crew turn rust into gold, whether a rare vintage Lancia comes in for a complete rebuild or a classic Chevy needs some "go faster" stripes. Through it all, Granger and his crew face shop-floor drama, gas-fueled egos and millions at stake.

programme.title: How It's Made
programme.desc: A look behind the scenes at how everyday things are manufactured. Typically each episode includes three to four products featured, with a mix consisting of common items such as jeans, aluminum foil and cereal, and less predictable ones like wax figurines, braille typewriters and pinball machines.

programme.title: Just for Laughs Gags
programme.desc: The Just for Laughs Festival has been a staple of the Canadian comedy scene for more than 30 years. Now, the festival lends its famous name to this hidden-camera prank show starring a Quebec-based troupe. Canada is the stage and its inhabitants are the characters - some might say victims - for the "Candid Camera"-style pranks featured on the half-hour series. Although the pranks last just a few minutes each, that's just long enough to inflict embarrassment on the subjects of the pranks.

programme.title: Just for Laughs: Gags
programme.desc: There's no sound, but there sure are plenty of laughs. This crazy Quebec-based troupe uses the city as its stage, and its inhabitants, or victims, as characters! People are caught in a twisted yet funny web of comedic deception. This updated "Candid Camera" is a tad more risque and a little kookier with its practical jokes. The little snippets last only a few minutes, and some look more painful than others.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Don't be ridiculous! When it comes to Internet videos run amok, however, the more zany, unbelievable and downright dangerous the clips are, the greater the chance they'll be shown on this series. It features amateur viral videos being critiqued by MTV personality Rob Dyrdek ("Rob Dyrdek's Fantasy Factory"), who knows a thing or two about pushing the envelope from his pro skateboarding days. With commentary from Sterling "Steelo" Brim and Chanel (the rapping receptionist from "Fantasy Factory"), Dyrdek breaks down the clips by putting them in such categories as "Hot Mess," "Worst Case Scenario," "Redneck Good Times" and "What Happened Last Night." It's sure to be seriously ridiculous.

When it comes to Internet videos run amok, however, the more zany, unbelievable and downright dangerous the clips are, the greater the chance they'll be shown on this series. It features amateur viral videos being critiqued by MTV personality Rob Dyrdek ("Rob Dyrdek's Fantasy Factory"), who knows a thing or two about pushing the envelope from his pro skateboarding days. With commentary from Sterling "Steelo" Brim and Chanel (the rapping receptionist from "Fantasy Factory"), Dyrdek breaks down the clips by putting them in such categories as "Hot Mess," "Worst Case Scenario," "Redneck Good Times" and "What Happened Last Night." It's sure to be seriously ridiculous.

programme.title: Paradise Canyon
programme.desc: Rough-and-tumble federal agent John Wyatt (John Wayne) receives an unusual undercover assignment: He must infiltrate the ranks of an Arizona-based medicine show. Wyatt's boss suspects the show's shifty-eyed proprietor, ex-convict Dr. Carter (Earle Hodgins), of running a massive counterfeiting operation. With the full cooperation of the local authorities, Wyatt poses as a sharpshooter and begins his investigation -- only to fall for Carter's beautiful daughter, Linda (Marion Burns).

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.

programme.title: Black Hills
programme.desc: When their father is shot by Dan Kirby (Terry Frost) after discovering a gold mine on his ranch, Larry Hadley (Steve Drake) and his sister, Janet (Shirley Patterson), ask foreman Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) for help in retaining their land. Eddie's arrival with sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) disrupts Dan's plans to take over the property. Desperate to obtain the ranch, Dan blackmails accountant Tuttle (Bill Fawcett) into forging a document that will help him take control.

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
programme.desc: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor.

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

programme.title: Little Big Horn
programme.desc: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. As they race against time, and Donlin pushes them hard through an arduous and dangerous journey, the Sioux start taking out the soldiers one at a time. Meanwhile, Donlin also clashes with Lt. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor).

programme.title: Nowhere to Hide
programme.desc: Military-industrial thugs kill a Marine (Daniel Hugh Kelly) to keep him quiet, but his ex-Marine wife (Amy Madigan) fights back.

programme.title: After Dark, My Sweet
programme.desc: After escaping from a mental hospital, drifting ex-boxer Kid Collie (Jason Patric) meets an alcoholic widow, Fay (Rachel Ward), who entices him into performing maintenance work at her estate. When crooked Uncle Bud (Bruce Dern) joins the two, Fay's darker side begins to appear. Bud and Fay concoct a scheme to kidnap the son of a local wealthy family and have Collie carry out the dirty work, to which the troubled ex-boxer agrees, but he soon has second thoughts.

programme.title: The Blood of Heroes
programme.desc: Another woman joins a future gladiator's band of "juggers" against fighters of the ruling elite.

programme.title: Lulu on the Bridge
programme.desc: A seemingly magic stone leads an aging, injured musician (Harvey Keitel) into love with a young, aspiring actress (Mira Sorvino).

programme.title: Night of the Living Dead
programme.desc: A ragtag group of Pennsylvanians barricade themselves in an old farmhouse to remain safe from a horde of flesh-eating ghouls that are ravaging the United States.

programme.title: American Heart
programme.desc: This unflinching drama tells the story of recently released ex-convict Jack Kelson (Jeff Bridges) as he struggles to begin a new life outside of prison and build a relationship with his estranged teenage son Nick (Edward Furlong). With the deck stacked against them, Jack falls back on old habits as they struggle amid the vagrants and criminals of an impoverished section of Seattle. Just when it appears that they might succeed, Jack's past comes back to haunt him.

programme.title: Any Last Words?
programme.desc: Wounded and hovering between life and death, Bat Masterson (Tom Lagleder) revisits the choices he has made and how they have defined his life.

programme.title: Thunder Town
programme.desc: Falsely accused of bank robbery, Jim Brandon (Bob Steele) is released from jail after his supposed criminal partner commits suicide. Back home, he finds that, aside from his stalwart friends, Betty Morgan (Ellen Hall) and Utah McGirk (Syd Saylor), most people in his small town still believe he's guilty. Drawn into a land dispute with Dunc Rankin (Edward Howard) over his own and Betty's ranches, Jim also discovers that his dead friend may have been murdered.

programme.title: The Lawless Frontier
programme.desc: The parents of John Tobin (John Wayne) have been murdered, and he wants justice. He sets out to find the killer, the evil gang leader Pandro Zanti (Earl Dwire), who hides from the law with disguises and almost kills old prospector Dusty (George Hayes) and his granddaughter. John rescues them and catches Zanti, only to face criminal charges from lawman Sheriff Williams (Jack Rockwell). Zanti is let go, and John must clear his name and establish who the real criminal is.

programme.title: The Westward Trail
programme.desc: City slicker Ann (Phyllis Planchard) and her little brother Tom (Steve Drake) leave Chicago and buy a ranch out West, and Ann struggles to run things. She meets Larson (Bob Duncan), a crooked local saloon keeper who woos her, but he also wants her land so he can get to the silver that's located on it. As part of his effort to grab all the land he can, Larson kills the town sheriff and assumes his position, alarming good-guy cowboy Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), who swoops in and tries to rescue Ann.

programme.title: Texas Terror
programme.desc: Just before Bess (Lucile Browne) returns home to the ranch owned by her father, Dan Matthews, robbers attack him and his friend, Sheriff John Higgins (John Wayne) -- and Dan is killed in the gunfight. Convinced that one of his shots resulted in Dan's death, John resigns as sheriff. Former sheriff Ed Williams (George Hayes) convinces John to work for Bess to make up for his error, and he becomes her foreman. John doesn't confide his involvement in her father's death, but Bess soon hears rumors.

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.

programme.title: The Hawk of Powder River
programme.desc: Vivian Chambers (Jennifer Holt) has a secret identity. She moonlights as "the Hawk," a villain who leads a gang of criminals. Vivian's uncle owns a ranch, and she wants to commandeer it. After her uncle catches a glimpse of the Hawk's secret lair, Vivian kills him and decides to go after his daughter, Carole (June Carlson), as well. Now it's up to Deputy Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) to save Carole and defeat Vivian and her bandit minions.

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
programme.desc: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor.

programme.title: Prairie Badmen
programme.desc: Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) and his pal, Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are riding west when they meet a traveling medicine show run by a doctor and his teenage son. Billy discovers that the doctor has a map showing the location of a stash of gold stolen from a local stagecoach company. Billy and the doctor favor returning the gold to its owners, while the son wants to keep it for themselves. When the teen runs off with the map and finds himself chased by outlaws, Billy rides out to save him.

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

programme.title: Prairie Outlaws
programme.desc: A retired singing ranger named Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and his friends Stormy Day (Al "Lash" La Rue) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) are asked to jump back into the saddle to protect the construction of a telegraph line across the desert. However, a gang of ruthless thugs led by the villainous Drake Dawson aim to make sure that telegraph line doesn't stay up. In between the gunfights, ambushes, revenge and some valiant heroism, Dean sings a song or two.

programme.title: The Navajo Kid
programme.desc: Gunslinger Tom Kirk (Bob Steele) is searching for the man who killed his adoptive father and the true identities of his biological parents. He rides into the town where the murder took place, but there Sheriff Landon (Edward Cassidy) warns him against vigilantism. This doesn't stop Tom from pursuing poker player Honest John (I. Stanford Jolley), who has the victim's ring. However, when John is shot with the same rare ammo that killed the elder Kirk, Tom realizes the murderer is still at large.

programme.title: American Heart
programme.desc: This unflinching drama tells the story of recently released ex-convict Jack Kelson (Jeff Bridges) as he struggles to begin a new life outside of prison and build a relationship with his estranged teenage son Nick (Edward Furlong). With the deck stacked against them, Jack falls back on old habits as they struggle amid the vagrants and criminals of an impoverished section of Seattle. Just when it appears that they might succeed, Jack's past comes back to haunt him.

programme.title: Played
programme.desc: Rival gangs hire a British thug (Mick Rossi), who was imprisoned for eight years, to complete a hit in Los Angeles.

programme.title: Blackheart
programme.desc: A con artist (Richard Grieco) leaves his partner for dead and pursues a woman (Fiona Loewi) with a $10 million inheritance.

programme.title: All Souls Day: Dia de los Muertos
programme.desc: When young lovers Joss (Travis Wester) and Alicia (Marisa Ramirez) arrive in a small Mexican town, they inadvertently stumble upon an attempted human sacrifice. Eventually they find their way to the local sheriff, Blanco (David Keith), and begin to piece together the supernatural puzzle, which involves the dead rising from their graves. As the village's dark history is revealed, it becomes clear that the evil stems from the immortal Vargas Diaz (Danny Trejo), who must be stopped at any cost.

programme.title: Chappaquiddick
programme.desc: On July 18, 1969, Sen. Ted Kennedy drives his car off of a bridge on Massachusetts' Chappaquiddick Island. The accident results in the death of passenger Mary Jo Kopechne, a 28-year-old campaign strategist who worked for Kennedy. The ongoing investigation into the mysterious and scandalous events forever alters Kennedy's political legacy -- and ultimately changes the course of presidential history.

When a case of mistaken identities leads to the bandits freeing harmless Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) instead, he decides to play along to help Billy. However, the real Brawley soon arrives to cause trouble.

programme.title: Doctor Who
programme.desc: "Doctor Who" is a classic science-fiction series with a cult following. The Doctor is called a "Time Lord," a time-traveling scientist from a far-off planet who travels through time and space in a shop known by the acronym TARDIS. A TARDIS is a machine that is larger on the inside than the outside and is supposed to change its appearance based on its surroundings. The Doctor is also able to evolve his biology, so he appears as many different people throughout the series. The Doctor loves Earth, so he makes many trips here to save the planet, or to enlist earthlings to help him with tasks in the galaxy.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 3 Alabama Crimson Tide (7-2) play the Vanderbilt Commodores (4-5) at FirstBank Stadium for an SEC matchup. Alabama enter on a two-game win streak and beat LSU 31-13, while Vanderbilt snapped a five-game skid and beat Mississippi State 25-23.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 19 Ole Miss Rebels (6-3) visit the Oklahoma Sooners at Memorial Stadium in Norman for an SEC matchup. Ole Miss seek to rebound after a 42-7 loss to Georgia and rely on Trinidad Chambliss, while Oklahoma beat Florida 23-7 in Week 10.

programme.title: Number One
programme.desc: Ron Catlan isn't the same football player he used to be. When the aging Saints quarterback injures his knee, the situation quickly gets worse. On the field, he contends with his injury and a talented rookie who further threatens his career. Off the field, he alienates his wife as he turns to drink and pursues an affair with a young woman. The former champion struggles to hold on before he plummets to the bottom.

programme.title: Carve Her Name With Pride
programme.desc: During World War II, Violette Szabo (Virginia McKenna) embarks on espionage missions in occupied France.

programme.title: The Fall of the House of Usher
programme.desc: Based on the classic story "The Fall of the House of Usher" by Edgar Allan Poe and directed by legendary filmmaker Roger Corman, this thriller features Vincent Price as Roderick Usher, a man who believes his family to be cursed by incurable madness. So sure is he of his family's doom, that when his sister Madeline (Myrna Fahey) announces her engagement to Philip Winthrop (Mark Damon), Roderick will stop at nothing to prevent their marriage and keep the Usher bloodline from continuing.

programme.title: The Gravedancers
programme.desc: After a funeral, several college friends reunite in a cemetery and reminisce about the former life of the deceased. The celebration starts to go too far after they get drunk and begin dancing on graves, and as a result, each of them becomes haunted by malevolent spirits.

programme.title: Black Sabbath
programme.desc: Karloff introduces tales of a haunted nurse (Jacqueline Pierreux), a stalked call-girl (Michèle Mercier) and a vampire (Boris Karloff).

programme.title: The Premature Burial
programme.desc: Based on Edgar Allan Poe's story about a cataleptic Englishman obsessed with the fear of being buried alive.

programme.title: The Initiation of Sarah
programme.desc: When a coed is humiliated by a group of sorority sisters, she is urged to get even by unleashing her psychic powers.

programme.title: The Ghost of Sierra de Cobre
programme.desc: Vivia Mandore, an heiress, enlists the services of a paranormal investigator to look into a suspected case of haunting involving the spirit of her deceased mother-in-law.

programme.title: He Ran All the Way
programme.desc: Nick Robey is a dim-witted thug who lives with his mother and scrapes by on petty crime. He and his slick accomplice, Al, plot a big-time payroll robbery, but their plan goes horribly awry when they're discovered by a police officer and Al is shot. Nick shoots back, hitting the officer and running for safety. While seeking cover, Nick meets Peggy Dobbs, a lonely young girl. They return to Peggy's house, where Nick holds her family hostage.

programme.title: The Sharkfighters
programme.desc: Navy pilot Ben Staves (Victor Mature) arrives at a research facility on a small Caribbean island to help develop a shark repellent for use by sailors and downed airmen. Partnered with scientists Leonard Evans (Philip Coolidge) and Harold Duncan (James Olson), Staves provides valuable information about his own time stranded in the ocean. But his impatient desire to finish the project quickly conflicts with the researchers' methodical precision, with potentially deadly results.

programme.title: Ordeal by Innocence
programme.desc: A 1950s U.S. scientist (Donald Sutherland) probes the murder of a British friend's (Christopher Plummer) wife (Faye Dunaway).

programme.title: The Naked Street
programme.desc: Rosalie (Anne Bancroft) is the sister of notorious, well-connected mobster Phil (Anthony Quinn). When Rosalie ends up pregnant by Nicky (Farley Granger), an upstart crook facing a death sentence, Phil uses his influence to clear the soon-to-be-father's name and get him out of prison so that he can marry Rosalie. When the young woman loses her baby because of a medical complication, Nicky promptly ditches her. But Phil doesn't take kindly to this, and decides to make Nicky's life a living hell.

programme.title: Return to Paradise
programme.desc: An island beauty (Roberta Haynes) and her people follow a beach bum (Gary Cooper) instead of a fire-and-brimstone preacher (Barry Jones).

programme.title: Assassination
programme.desc: A Secret Service agent (Charles Bronson) and the president's wife (Jill Ireland) flee from a senator's (Michael Ansara) hit man.

programme.title: Greyfriars Bobby
programme.desc: When his owner, police officer John Gray (Thomas Lockyer), is killed in the line of duty, Bobby, a particularly faithful West Highland terrier, takes up residence in the graveyard where Gray was interred. Bobby charms everyone he meets, and the canine's continued exploits make him a legend among the local working poor. When oppressive factory owner Smithie (Sean Pertwee) plots to kill Bobby, Gray's impoverished young ward, Ewan (Oliver Golding), must protect him from a ruthless dog catcher.

programme.title: The Witches
programme.desc: The same actress (Silvana Mangano) plays five different women in five sketches by five Italian filmmakers.

programme.title: Killing Me Softly
programme.desc: A young American in London begins a passionate and kinky affair with a handsome stranger who may be a killer.

programme.title: Master of the World
programme.desc: Mad inventor Capt. Robur kidnaps a team on a government expedition to investigate a mysterious crater in Pennsylvania. The team is taken aboard Robur's spectacularly engineered air ship, the Albatross, which Robur plans to fly around the world to various military installations in his desperate desire to eradicate weapons of mass destruction, thereby bringing about world peace. The kidnapped team's leader, John Strock, responds by planning an uprising.

programme.title: Assassination
programme.desc: A Secret Service agent (Charles Bronson) and the president's wife (Jill Ireland) flee from a senator's (Michael Ansara) hit man.

programme.title: The Bride Wore Black
programme.desc: After newly widowed Julie Kohler's mother stops her from committing suicide, she hatches a different plan to deal with her grief. In a small black book, she lists five men. One by one she visits the men with murderous intentions, assuming different identities to get close to them. Only one man remains elusive, having been captured by the cops before Julie could reach him -- but despite the obstacles, Julie intends to see her task through to the end.

programme.title: Blood Vows: The Story of a Mafia Wife
programme.desc: Fashion designer Marian (Melissa Gilbert) meets the man of her dreams, dashing lawyer Edward Moran (Joe Penny). Their attraction is instant, but after the lovebirds get married, Marian makes a shocking discovery about her in-laws: They're in the Mafia, and that includes her dear husband, Edward. To Marian's horror, she soon finds herself entangled in their drug-running activities. And now that she's part of the crime family, there's no way out -- except in a casket.

programme.title: The Assassin
programme.desc: A government agent (Richard Todd) searches Venice for a World War II hero turned assassin.

programme.title: We Still Kill the Old Way
programme.desc: A teacher (Gian Maria Volonte) falls for a woman (Irene Papas) whose husband was recently murdered on a hunting trip.

programme.title: A Kiss Before Dying
programme.desc: Amoral Bud Corliss (Robert Wagner) pursues young heiress Dorie Kingship (Joanne Woodward) in the hopes of getting his hands on the fortune amassed by her father (George Macready). But after Dorie succumbs to Bud's charms and becomes pregnant as a result, he fears she'll be cut off by the family and murders her in a fashion that makes it look as if the poor girl committed suicide. When Bud tries to cozy up with Dorie's grieving sister, Ellen (Virginia Leith), she begins to suspect his intentions.

programme.title: Vice Squad
programme.desc: Capt. Barnaby (Edward G. Robinson), leader of the Los Angeles Vice Squad, is trying to track down the murderers of a beat cop. To do this, he pulls some strings to coerce help from Mona Ross (Paulette Goddard), the madam behind a local escort ring. Using this lead and further help from an informant, Barnaby hunts down a pair of bank robbers he suspects are the killers. However, the criminals prove to be hard to catch, so Barnaby must stay determined.

programme.title: Tomorrow Is Forever
programme.desc: In 1918, Elizabeth MacDonald (Claudette Colbert) learns with shock that her husband, John Andrew (Orson Welles), has been killed in the war. Elizabeth bears John's son and eventually marries her kindly boss. Unknown to her, John has survived but is horribly disfigured and remains in Europe. Years later, on the eve of World War II, Elizabeth refuses to agree to her son's request to enlist and is stunned when an eerily familiar stranger named Kessler arrives from abroad and becomes involved.

programme.title: The Satan Bug
programme.desc: Special Agent Lee Barrett (George Maharis) joins forces with Ann Williams (Anne Francis), a general's daughter, to recover a biological weapon stolen from a secret government lab. Learning that the pathogen could destroy all life on Earth, they focus their attention on a mysterious millionaire who may have orchestrated the theft. After annihilating a small town in Florida, the villain turns his attention to Los Angeles -- and the duo must race to stop the city's destruction.

programme.title: Call of the Wild
programme.desc: Based on Jack London's classic about two gold-seekers who forge their way to the Klondike with their faithful dog Buck.

programme.title: True Heart
programme.desc: Twin brother and sister Sam and Bonnie, who argue frequently, become stranded after surviving a horrific plane crash in the Canadian wilderness. While struggling through the forest, they meet a wily Native North American named Khonanesta, who agrees to help them reunite with their family. As the trio traverses the treacherous wood, they strive to elude poachers who wish to hunt Khonanesta's adored Kodiak bear companion.

programme.title: Flight From Ashiya
programme.desc: Stationed in Ashiya, Japan, U.S. Air Force Rescue Service members Master Sgt. Mike Takashima (Yul Brynner), Lt. Col. Glenn Stevenson (Richard Widmark) and Lt. John Gregg (George Chakiris) all carry personal demons stemming from a past event. When the orders come down to rescue stranded Japanese survivors of a shipwreck caused by a storm, the three men jump into action. On their way through the still violent storm, each shares the tale from his past that has affected him to this day.

programme.title: Legend of the Lost
programme.desc: Brit Paul Bonnard (Rossano Brazzi) enlists gruff American Joe January (John Wayne) to help him find a hidden treasure that is worth a fortune. Before long, they are joined by prostitute Dita (Sophia Loren), who is moved by Bonnard's earnestness, and the three embark on a journey through the wild in hopes of finding an ancient lost city. They finally stumble upon the riches, but, after Bonnard feuds with Dita, he angrily takes the jewels and supplies, and leaves his partners to die in the desert.

programme.title: Call of the Jungle
programme.desc: Trouble comes to a tropical island paradise when sacred pearls are stolen from a tribal temple. Local amateur sleuth Tana (Ann Corio) decides to investigate the matter to find out who's responsible, but following leads only earns her a place on the authorities' list of suspects. Meanwhile, a police officer, Jim (James Bush), is injured while working on the case, and Tana, nursing him back to health, attempts to get him to team up with her to track down the real crooks.

programme.title: The Emerald Forest
programme.desc: American Bill Markham (Powers Boothe) has taken his family to the jungles of Brazil, where he has been hired to design a dam. Unexpectedly, a native tribe abducts his son, Tommy (Charley Boorman). Bill spends an entire decade looking for Tommy, only to discover that the boy has adopted the ways of the indigenous people he's been living with. Bill tries to convince his son to return to his family, but their reunion is interrupted when another group of natives attacks Tommy's tribe.

programme.title: Flatbed Annie & Sweetiepie: Lady Truckers
programme.desc: Two women join forces to keep an expensive trucking rig out of the clutches of repossessors and hijackers.

programme.title: Unholy Rollers
programme.desc: A roller-derby newcomer (Claudia Jennings) soon makes enemies for refusing to play by the unwritten rules.

programme.title: Ski Patrol
programme.desc: Pops (Ray Walston) is the longtime owner of an easygoing ski lodge, but its future is put in jeopardy by cutthroat businessman Sam Maris (Martin Mull). Intent on replacing the lodge with an enormous resort, Maris schemes to get Pops' lease revoked. What he doesn't count on is the mountain's madcap ski patrol. As the crazed crew leaps into action to save Pops' business, Maris begins to wish he'd never thought of building his eyesore on their winter playground.

programme.title: Fearless Frank
programme.desc: Slain by Chicago gangsters, country boy Frank (Jon Voight) comes back as a caped superhero with a bad clone, False Frank.

programme.title: Boardheads
programme.desc: Two surfers show three wealthy men how to woo women on a Southern California beach.

programme.title: Wild in the Streets
programme.desc: Archetypal 1960s musician Max Frost (Christopher Jones) lends his backing to a Senate candidate who wants to give 18-year-olds the right to vote, but he takes things a step further than expected. Inspired by their hero's words, Max's fans pressure their leaders into extending the vote to citizens as young as 15. Max and his followers capitalize on their might by bringing new issues to the fore, but, drunk on power, they soon take generational warfare to terrible extremes.

programme.title: Masquerade
programme.desc: The British government is in negotiations with the Middle Eastern oil-rich nation of Ramaut to allow in British drilling agencies, but Ramaut withdraws from the talks, leaving Britain desperate. British Col. Drexel (Jack Hawkins) is enlisted in a covert operation to kidnap the Ramaut prince, Jamil (Christopher Witty), in order to force an oil agreement between the countries. Drexel brings in American David Frazer (Cliff Robertson) to assist, but Frazer finds someone else has plans for Jamil.

programme.title: Operation Kid Brother
programme.desc: Sean's brother plays a hypnotic plastic surgeon (Neil Connery), pressed into service as a James Bond-type spy.

programme.title: Flatbed Annie & Sweetiepie: Lady Truckers
programme.desc: Two women join forces to keep an expensive trucking rig out of the clutches of repossessors and hijackers.

programme.title: Unholy Rollers
programme.desc: A roller-derby newcomer (Claudia Jennings) soon makes enemies for refusing to play by the unwritten rules.

programme.title: Ski Patrol
programme.desc: Pops (Ray Walston) is the longtime owner of an easygoing ski lodge, but its future is put in jeopardy by cutthroat businessman Sam Maris (Martin Mull). Intent on replacing the lodge with an enormous resort, Maris schemes to get Pops' lease revoked. What he doesn't count on is the mountain's madcap ski patrol. As the crazed crew leaps into action to save Pops' business, Maris begins to wish he'd never thought of building his eyesore on their winter playground.

programme.title: Fearless Frank

programme.title: The Mugger
programme.desc: A police psychiatrist lends his expertise to the hunt for a purse snatcher who leaves his victims with a facial scar.

programme.title: The Cat Burglar
programme.desc: A thief (Jack Hogan) lands in hot water after stealing a briefcase that contains a scientific formula.

programme.title: The Big Caper
programme.desc: A crook's (James Gregory) partners (Rory Calhoun, Mary Costa) pose as newlyweds near Camp Pendleton, Calif., to set up a Marine payroll heist.

programme.title: Guns, Girls and Gangsters
programme.desc: A Las Vegas singer (Mamie Van Doren) plans an armored-car robbery with her husband's (Lee Van Cleef) ex-cellmate (Gerald Mohr).

programme.title: Storm Fear
programme.desc: A wounded bank robber (Cornel Wilde) hides with his gang at his brother (Dan Duryea) and sister-in-law's (Jean Wallace) farm in a snowstorm.

programme.title: Black Tuesday
programme.desc: Vincent Canelli (Edward G. Robinson) and his comrade in crime, Peter Manning (Peter Graves), bust out of prison on the day Canelli is supposed to be executed for murder. The convicts take prisoners with them, including a priest (Milburn Stone), and hide out in an abandoned warehouse. The plan is for Canelli to grab the loot that got them in the slammer to begin with. But their plan is complicated when the police surround them, and Canelli threatens to start killing hostages one by one.

programme.title: Hidden Fear
programme.desc: A U.S. lawman (John Payne) busts Copenhagen counterfeiters to help his sister, falsely accused of murder.

programme.title: Hit and Run
programme.desc: An old junk dealer's (Hugo Haas) chorus-girl bride (Cleo Moore) and helper (Vince Edwards) run into his twin brother.

programme.title: Inside the Mafia
programme.desc: A mob assassin (Cameron Mitchell) holds innocent hostages at an airport in upstate New York.

programme.title: The Organization
programme.desc: When an executive and a night watchman are killed in a San Francisco office building, Lt. Virgil Tibbs is called in to investigate and discovers the watchman was actually killed elsewhere. Soon Tibbs is contacted by urban revolutionaries who confess to kidnapping -- but not killing -- the watchman in a botched attempt to expose a heroin ring operating out of the building. Tibbs believes them, but when his superiors learn of his ties to the group, he's suspended from the force.

programme.title: The Wilby Conspiracy
programme.desc: English engineer Jim Keogh (Michael Caine) and black anti-apartheid activist Shack Twala (Sidney Poitier) go on the run together in the 1970s South Africa after falling foul of the police. Aided by Shack's lawyer, Rina (Prunella Gee), the two attempt to make their way to Cape Town where Shack hopes to return a diamond stash to the African National Congress and in turn seek help from the Congress' leader, Wilby (Joe De Graft). Unbeknownst to the pair, they are being followed.

programme.title: Pressure Point
programme.desc: Frustrated by his inability to help an African-American patient who hates whites, a psychiatrist (Peter Falk) asks his superior (Sidney Poitier) to release him from the case. The superior relates a case from his own past during World War II when he treated a young Nazi (Bobby Darin) who despised blacks. Explaining the tragic results of the case, the older psychiatrist encourages his younger colleague not to be swayed by the patient's attitude, to remain objective and to stick with his treatment.

programme.title: Paris Blues
programme.desc: Despite being far from home, American jazz musicians Ram Bowen (Paul Newman) and Eddie Cook (Sidney Poitier) are content living and working in Paris. Ram knows it's the best place for him to develop his musical reputation, and Eddie is far away from the racism that once greeted him on a regular basis. But after meeting and falling in love with American tourists Lillian (Joanne Woodward) and Connie (Diahann Carroll), the pair must decide whether their artistic integrity is worth abandoning.

programme.title: They Call Me Mister Tibbs!
programme.desc: In this sequel to "In The Heat of the Night," Detective Virgil Tibbs (Sidney Poitier) must solve the murder of a prostitute. The last person witnessed with the victim is Tibbs' friend, Logan Sharpe (Martin Landau), a preacher and activist. Despite his loyalty, Tibbs must investigate when Sharpe admits having visited the prostitute. In addition to his police work, Tibbs must also ease tension with his wife (Barbara McNair), who wants him to spend more time with her and their children.

programme.title: The Organization

Virgil Tibbs is called in to investigate and discovers the watchman was actually killed elsewhere. programme.title: Across 110th Street
programme.desc: After a robbery in Harlem turns into a scene of mass murder, promising young black police officer William Pope (Yaphet Kotto) is assigned to the case, along with surly, prejudiced Italian-American cop Frank Mattelli (Anthony Quinn). The pair clashes during their tense investigation as they try to track down the three suspects and apprehend them. Also searching for the fugitives is ruthless mobster Nick D'Salvio (Tony Franciosa), who will stop at nothing to retrieve the stolen money.

programme.title: The Children of Times Square
programme.desc: The mother (Joanna Cassidy) of a runaway (Brandon Douglas) tries to save him from a cocaine dealer's (Howard E. Rollins Jr.) youth gang in New York.

programme.title: Hurricane Streets
programme.desc: A stark portrait of kids living on the edge, "Hurricane Streets" focuses on one teenager's fight to change the circumstances of his life. Brendan Sexton III delivers a powerful performance in the central role of Marcus, a street-smart teen who dreams of the day that he can escape the city trap and live with his mother in the wide open spaces of New Mexico.

programme.title: Hell up in Harlem
programme.desc: In Harlem, N.Y., crime boss Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) is gravely injured while escaping a hit ordered by the corrupt district attorney, D'Angelo (Gerald Gordon). As he recovers, his father, Papa Gibbs (Julius W. Harris), assumes control of the gang, which angers Tommy's best henchman, Zach (Tony King), who goes on to collaborate with D'Angelo and frame Papa Gibbs for the murder of Tommy's ex-wife. This sets off a series of bloody betrayals that ricochet within the crime world.

programme.title: Cotton Comes to Harlem
programme.desc: Harlem's African-American population is being ripped off by the Rev. Deke O'Malley (Calvin Lockhart), who dishonestly claims that small donations will secure parcels of land in Africa. When New York City police officers Gravedigger Jones (Godfrey Cambridge) and Coffin Ed Johnson (Raymond St. Jacques) look into O'Malley's scam, they learn that the cash is being smuggled inside a bale of cotton. But the police, O'Malley and lots of others find themselves scrambling when the money goes missing.

programme.title: Carbon Copy
programme.desc: Walter Whitney is a successful executive who resides in an upscale Southern California suburb. Like all of his friends and neighbors, Walter is white, and he is shocked when he learns he has a son he never knew about -- black teen Roger Porter (Denzel Washington). Despite his surprise, Walter welcomes Roger into his home; unfortunately, the less accepting Mrs. Whitney (Susan Saint James) boots both of them out of the house, and Walter's racist boss fires him, leaving him in a tough spot.

programme.title: The Wild Pair
programme.desc: An FBI agent (Beau Bridges) and a detective (Bubba Smith) tie ghetto drugs and mayhem to a colonel's (Lloyd Bridges) white supremacists.

programme.title: Hollywood Shuffle
programme.desc: Aspiring actor and hot-dog stand employee Bobby Taylor (Robert Townsend) catches the ire of his grandmother (Helen Martin) for auditioning for a role in the regrettably titled exploitation film Jivetime Jimmy's Revenge. When Tinseltown Studios casts Taylor in the title role, he has a series of conflicted dreams satirizing African-American stereotypes in Hollywood, and must reconcile his career goals with his desire to remain a positive role model for his little brother (Craigus R Johnson).

programme.title: Census Taker
programme.desc: Fed up with his intrusiveness, members of a family shoot a census taker and try to hide his body from a detective.

programme.title: Blind Rage
programme.desc: A CIA agent (Fred Williamson) in a pancake house closes the case of five blind bank robbers in the Philippines.

programme.title: The Wild Pair
programme.desc: An FBI agent (Beau Bridges) and a detective (Bubba Smith) tie ghetto drugs and mayhem to a colonel's (Lloyd Bridges) white supremacists.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Après s'être fait tirer dessus par Luke Harris en Irak, Gibbs est transporté à bord d'un navire-hôpital et tous les moyens sont mis en œuvre pour tenter de le sauver.

programme.title: Détectives privés
programme.desc: Une cousine d'Angie lui demande de retrouver un bijou familial ayant été volé de sa chambre d'hôtel la journée de son mariage ; l'enquête prend une autre tournure alors que la mère d'Angie semble être le principal suspect.

programme.title: Blue Bloods
programme.desc: Jamie aide Joe à retrouver une adolescente victime de trafic sexuel ; leur enquête est étroitement liée à celle de Danny et de Baez, qui tentent d'élucider le meurtre d'une femme qui faisait partie du programme de protection des témoins.

programme.title: Bête noire
programme.desc: Pascale, en crise, est retrouvée dans une église ; aux yeux d'Éliane, la théorie du délire religieux ne fait plus aucun doute ; Boisvert va à la rencontre d'Alexia, la maîtresse de Jean-Philippe, et tente de retracer le père biologique de Pascale.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Le stress du mariage imminent de McGee et Delilah monte d'un cran lorsque Delilah est transportée à l'hôpital.

programme.title: Manuel de la vie sauvage
programme.desc: Kevin s'échine dans un travail éreintant et moralement discutable pour soutenir Laurent, son coloc qui peine à se remettre de sa rupture avec Ève ; une trahison force Kevin à s'isoler.

programme.title: Poker Face
programme.desc: Lorsque la Barracuda rétro de Charlie attire l'attention d'une équipe qui tourne un film indépendant, sa journée sur le plateau d'un funérarium familial lui offre un aperçu des hiérarchies farfelues et des longues heures de travail.

programme.title: MacGyver
programme.desc: Un double rendez-vous amoureux vire au chaos; Mac et Desi ont été témoins d'un meurtre à l'arrière d'un restaurant; tandis qu'ils s'efforcent de retrouver le tueur, Riley tente de cacher à son nouveau petit ami, Aubrey, la nature de son travail.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: Amy aide Lisa avec son cheval ; pendant ce temps, Tim et Shane vivent un moment difficile et Katie se retrouve à la tête d'une manifestation ; puis, Jack renoue avec ses racines de musique country.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Hetty charge Deeks et Kensi d'assurer la protection de Jack, l'ex-fiancé de cette dernière, entré en possession d'une liste de contacts importants en Afghanistan.

programme.title: Bull
programme.desc: Brillant, impétueux et charmant, le Dr Bull est l'ultime marionnettiste alors qu'il combine la psychologie, l'intuition et la technologie pour comprendre ce qui peut faire pencher l'avis d'un juré, d'un avocat ou d'un témoin.

programme.title: Bull
programme.desc: Dr Bull et son équipe doivent formuler une nouvelle stratégie de défense lorsqu'ils découvrent qu'un juré a des préjugés défavorables envers le sexe de leur client, une pilote accusée de négligence criminelle après l'écrasement de l'un de ses avions.

programme.title: Bull
programme.desc: Bull et son équipe abordent un jury partiel contre leur client, une femme accusée du meurtre d'un célèbre athlète qui l'aurait prétendument agressée; la cause amène Benny dans un face-à-face avec son ancienne flamme.

programme.title: FBI
programme.desc: Cinq hommes importants du milieu new-yorkais sont tués; l'enquête des agents du FBI les mène à entrer en contact avec un membre clé du cartel d'Antonio Vargas; au programme: la confrontation tant attendue entre Isobel et Antonio Vargas.

programme.title: FBI: recherchés
programme.desc: Un ancien ami et collègue de Crosby dans l'armée est attaqué au beau milieu de la nuit; l'équipe soupçonne qu'il s'agit d'une transaction de drogue ayant mal tourné; cependant, l'enquête mène tout droit vers un dangereux réseau de conspiration.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: L'agent spécial Leroy Jethro Gibbs, du Service d'enquêtes criminelles de la Marine, dirige un groupe chargé d'enquêter sur des crimes, allant du meurtre et de l'espionnage au terrorisme, qui comportent des preuves liées au personnel de la Marine.

programme.title: NCIS: Sydney
programme.desc: Un officier de la marine américaine est arrêté en lien avec un meurtre, alors qu'il tentait de détruire une carte au trésor; pour tenter d'élucider le mystère, l'équipe se lance dans une course contre-la-montre particulièrement complexe; reste à savoir si le légendaire trésor sera retrouvé.

programme.title: NCIS: origines
programme.desc: Une information de source anonyme mène l'équipe à la découverte du corps d'un jeune membre de la marine sur une scène de crime macabre; Randy soupçonne que le crime serait lié à un cas précédent où une pièce de monnaie avait été retrouvée dans la gorge de la victime; pendant ce temps, Frank tente de retrouver des colis de grande valeur destinés à son frère Mason.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Le fils d'un sergent de la marine est retrouvé sans vie à une fête pour souligner son retour à la maison après un séjour derrière les barreaux.

programme.title: Élémentaire
programme.desc: Holmes et Watson s'attèlent à la lourde tâche d'essayer de trouver un potentiel remplaçant au détective Bell, puisque tout semble indiquer qu'il quittera bientôt pour d'autres fonctions.

programme.title: Liaison fatale
programme.desc: Au présent, Dan renoue douloureusement avec son ancienne femme ; avec l'aide d'un ami, Dan cherche des preuves qui pourraient l'exonérer, démontrer qu'il n'a pas commis de meurtre.

programme.title: Meurtre sur la côte ouest
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un vieil homme est assassiné dans sa maison en bord de mer, l'intuition d'Alberg le conduit vers George Wilcox, le beau-frère octogénaire de la victime, qui a signalé le meurtre.

programme.title: Détectives privés
programme.desc: La créatrice de mode Carla Costa engage Shade et Angie pour surveiller sa nouvelle collection, mais celle-ci est volée quelques jours seulement avant le défilé de sa carrière.

programme.title: CIA
programme.desc: Colin et son équipe reçoivent une information concernant un attentat imminent; ils en viennent à retrouver un jeune homme kidnappé il y a neuf ans, en Turquie; pour tenter de déjouer l'attentat, ils doivent enquêter, dans les moindres détails, sur ces neuf années dans la vie du jeune homme; pendant ce temps, Bill s'intéresse de très près à une personne proche de Colin.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Gibbs demande à l'équipe d'aider l'agent du DEA Luis Mitchell dans une affaire, mais DiNozzo découvre qu'il y a un lien personnel entre l'agent Gibbs et son souhait d'aider Mitchell à résoudre l'enquête.

programme.title: Détectives privés
programme.desc: Alors que Shade et Angie s'adaptent à leurs nouveaux rôles en tant que partenaires à parts égales, la propriétaire d'une équipe de course automobile les embauche afin d'enquêter sur des menaces adressées à son entreprise et à son pilote.

programme.title: Blue Bloods
programme.desc: Le boulot prend une tournure dangereuse pour plusieurs membres de la famille Reagan quand Eddie et Jamie sont appelés à s'occuper d'un cas de violence domestique lié à une enquête menée par Danny et Baez.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: Amy aide Georgie à redécouvrir sa passion pour le saut d'obstacles; Lou est surprise par la décision de Peter de revenir s'installer à Heartland; un événement spécial permet à Tim de donner un coup de main à la fois à Jessica et à son école de rodéo.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Gibbs, McGee et Torres se rendent dans une région éloignée au Paraguay, contrôlée par un groupe de rebelles.

programme.title: Ghosts: fantômes à la maison
programme.desc: La soeur de Jay, Bela, visite le manoir Woodstone et amène un ami adorable, ce qui pousse Sam à déclencher une romance entre eux dans le même esprit des films romantiques de Noël qu'elle aime; les fantômes concoctent un plan de vacances différent.

programme.title: Ghosts: fantômes à la maison
programme.desc: Sam et Thorfinn sont pris entre deux feux alors que le plan élaboré par Bela, la soeur de Jay, et les fantômes tourne mal; de plus, le mariage d'Isaac avec Béatrice met en lumière l'appréhension qu'il a eue à communiquer ses sentiments à Nigel.

programme.title: La belle et la bête
programme.desc: Vincent et Cat tentent de retrouver une vie normale malgré les menaces omniprésentes ; Tess prend un très gros risque en protégeant Vincent d'un journaliste trop curieux.

programme.title: FBI
programme.desc: Un braquage dans une clinique communautaire tourne au drame; l'équipe enquête alors sur un réseau de trafiquants de drogue et découvre que le médecin de la clinique pourrait être plus impliqué que tout le monde le croyait; pendant ce temps, un problème familial crée un froid entre Isobel et sa belle-fille.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: Amy aide Georgie à redécouvrir sa passion pour le saut d'obstacles; Lou est surprise par la décision de Peter de revenir s'installer à Heartland; un événement spécial permet à Tim de donner un coup de main à la fois à Jessica et à son école de rodéo.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Afin de localiser Arkady en Russie, l'équipe du NCIS assiste à un gala à Los Angeles avec la fille d'Arkady dans le but d'accéder à l'ordinateur du consul général russe.

programme.title: Hawaii 5-0
programme.desc: Le 5-0 enquête sur le meurtre de Kevin Okada, un agent infiltré du FBI ; il se trouve que la victime était sur le point de se marier avec Tamiko, la fille de Hajime Masuda, un chef des Yakuzas.

programme.title: Hawaii 5-0
programme.desc: Danny et le reste de l'équipe enquêtent sur le meurtre d'un conducteur de ligne et d'un passager ; le passager était déjà connu des services de police ; la s?ur de McGarrett, Mary, découvre un laboratoire de méthamphétamine.

programme.title: Hawaii 5-0
programme.desc: L'ancien pirate fugitif, Aaron Wright, refait surface pour demander de l'aide au 5-0 lorsque ses collègues de la NSA ont tous été assassinés.

programme.title: FBI
programme.desc: Une jeune femme est tuée alors qu'elle rentre chez elle après une somptueuse fête sur un yacht; l'équipe mène une enquête.

programme.title: FBI: recherchés
programme.desc: Un double meurtre est commis dans une petite ville; une équipe tente de traquer la personne suspecte qui s'affiche comme une justicière; sa mission: effectuer des recherches sur le Web sur des histoires de crime, puis se venger sur les suspects.

programme.title: FBI

When Max finds out that John is experiencing family troubles and financial ruin, however, he steps in to help. Their bond is further cemented when John has a health scare and Max makes the ultimate sacrifice for his friend.
