programme.desc: Aurora, dix ans, demande à un tueur à gages d'éliminer le monstre qui, selon elle, a dévoré toute sa famille. Pour la protéger, il devra affronter une horde d'assassins tout en acceptant l'idée que certains monstres existent bel et bien.

programme.title: Le pacte du silence
programme.desc: Lorsque cinq amis provoquent par inadvertance un accident de voiture mortel, ils dissimulent leur implication et font le pacte de garder le secret plutôt que d'en subir les conséquences. Un an plus tard, le passé revient les hanter lorsqu'ils apprennent que quelqu'un sait ce qu'ils ont fait l'été dernier. Traqués par un mystérieux tueur, ils cherchent bientôt de l'aide auprès de deux survivants du légendaire massacre de Southport de 1997.

programme.title: Inside
programme.desc: Dans une prison pour adultes, Mel lutte avec la culpabilité liée à un crime d'enfance en écrivant une lettre de réparation. Partageant sa cellule avec le tueur repenti Mark Shepard, il est entraîné dans un complot visant à l'assassiner, déchiré entre remords et violence.

programme.title: L'intrus
programme.desc: Lorsque Matthew, un vendeur solitaire de Los Angeles dans la vingtaine, fait la rencontre d'Oliver, une vedette de la pop en pleine ascension, il saisit l'occasion de se faufiler au sein de son cercle branché. Cependant, y rester ne sera pas une sinécure.

programme.title: R.L. Stine's Pumpkinhead 2
programme.desc: Lorsqu'une nouvelle malédiction liée aux Pumpkinheads s'éveille dans la ville de Redhaven, Sam et Becka doivent l'arrêter avant qu'elle ne s'empare de toute la communauté. Cette fois, un adolescent victime d'intimidation découvre un grimoire interdit qui réveille une ancienne malédiction, faisant surgir des enfants à tête de citrouille issus de sacrifices passés.

programme.desc: Lorsqu'un nouveau Ghostface surgit dans la paisible ville où Sidney Prescott a reconstruit sa vie, ses pires cauchemars refont surface. Quand sa fille devient la prochaine cible, Sidney n'a d'autre choix que de reprendre le combat. Déterminée à protéger les siens, elle devra affronter les démons de son passé pour tenter de mettre fin une bonne fois pour toutes au bain de sang.

programme.title: Les voyeurs
programme.desc: Pippa et son petit ami Thomas viennent d'emménager dans un bel appartement avec une vue sur Montréal et l'appartement d'en face. Cependant, le couple épie de plus en plus la vie glamour et sexy du couple qui y vit.

programme.title: Vie privée
programme.desc: Dr Lilian Steiner, une psychanalyste américaine installée à Paris, sent sa vie bien ordonnée vaciller après le décès soudain d'un de ses patients. Entre des tensions familiales et des obstacles professionnels, elle se retrouve hantée par le désir de comprendre ce qui s'est vraiment passé, alors que tout pointe vers un suicide. Plus elle enquête, plus elle doute. Elle s'enfonce alors dans un enchevêtrement de doutes et de mystères.

programme.desc: Caro héberge son ennemie d'enfance, Philippa, devenue héritière d'une maison de couture. Ensemble, elles relèvent des défis et poursuivent leurs rêves.

programme.desc: Wall Street baron Steven Taylor (Michael Douglas) discovers that his pretty young wife, Emily (Gwyneth Paltrow), is cheating on him. But what concerns him more than her infidelity is the hope of profiting from her untimely death. Emily has millions, and Steve's own financial empire is collapsing before his eyes. He hires her lover, David (Viggo Mortensen), to murder her. The plan -- to stage a break-in that will look like a random murder -- turns out to be far from perfect.

programme.title: Sleeping Dogs
programme.desc: Suffering from memory loss, a former homicide detective tries to solve a brutal murder that he can't recall. As he pieces together evidence from a decade-old investigation, he soon uncovers a sinister web of buried secrets tied to his forgotten past.

programme.desc: Defense attorney Martin Vail takes on jobs for money and prestige rather than any sense of the greater good. Vail finds himself up against his ex-pupil and ex-lover, but as the case progresses and the Church's dark secrets are revealed, Vail finds that what appeared a simple case takes on a darker, more dangerous aspect.

Standing between her and her quest, however, is her parole officer, Travis Lehman (Tommy Lee Jones). Libby poses a challenge to the cynical officer, one that forces him to face up to his own failings while pitting him against his superiors and law enforcement colleagues.

Jilted by Dan, Alex becomes unstable, her behavior escalating from aggressive pursuit to obsessive stalking. Even worse, Clark's employers renege on the holiday bonus he needs.

Unable to shake the feeling that he doesn't fit in, the adult Buddy travels to New York, in full elf uniform, in search of his real father. As it happens, this is Walter Hobbs (James Caan), a cynical businessman. After a DNA test proves this, Walter reluctantly attempts to start a relationship with the childlike Buddy with increasingly chaotic results.

programme.title: The Year Without a Santa Claus

Elves Jingle and Jangle scour the world to find people who still believe, hoping to convince the jolly old elf to make his trip anyway. They run into trouble in Southtown, however, and the only way they can get out of their predicament is to make it snow in the warm climate. Meanwhile, Santa sees evidence that people do still believe, and a little girl's touching letter prompts him to pack up the sleigh and head out on his annual trek, making a special stop in the now-snowy Southtown.

programme.desc: Andrew gives holiday turkey the Wild Game Kitchen treatment with grilled turkey tetrazzini and a butter basted Cajun-spiced whole bird roasted over crawfish, andouille and cornbread stuffing.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew cooks an all-venison feast, starting with charred Indonesian satay and a deeply savory peanut sauce, then tackles a classic Wellington with mushroom duxelles, prosciutto, puff pastry and Bordelaise.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew butchers a whole bison leg before diving in to grinding meat for bison brats, grilling them up and topping with homemade spicy mustard. Then, he grills Middle Eastern-inspired kebabs to serve over flatbread for a feast built for sharing.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew builds a massive Chicago-style fried beef sandwich with peppers, onions and molten cheese before tackling true snout-to-tail cooking: a whole simmered cow head transformed into crispy tacos de cabeza with two salsas.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern grills beloved shrimp in two distinct ways. He starts with jumbo shrimp and country ham skewers glazed with sweet-hot pepper jelly. Then, he creates Asian-inspired shrimp, served over crispy basmati rice and a complex sambal.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. Then, he slow-roasts a whole leg over fire, served Southern-style with pickled cherries, glazed onions & mustard sauce.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew takes on "little fish, big fish," cooking grilled whole small fish over Japanese charcoal with sesame spinach, and a larger fish in a bold puttanesca-style dish. Simple techniques, big flavor, and a case for eating lower on the food chain.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew cooks yellowtail two ways: grilled collars with a sweet, savory Filipino-inspired adobo sauce, and grilled filets with miso sauce, shiso butter, and charred vegetables. A lesson in using the whole fish and getting more from every cut.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Goose, one of Andrew's favorite game birds, is prepared two ways: a French onion soup-style grilled breast sandwich with caramelized onions and melted cheese, and a whole bird, cured, roasted on a beer can, and served with an apple-fennel salad.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew tackles suckling pig with two recipes-his take on a three-cup braise with soy, rice wine, and sesame oil, served with plancha fried rice, and a whole pig roasted over open fire and pulled for Philly-style pork sandwiches with broccoli rabe.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew gives squab the game-day treatment with two bold recipes: crispy Buffalo-style fried squab with blue cheese and ranch, and red chile grilled squab taquitos with green tomatillo salsa, cotija and crema.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Andrew turns wild boar into the ultimate game-day spread with boar and black bean chili topped with crisp cornbread waffles, and pulled boar sliders braised low and slow in Carolina Gold mustard sauce.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: It's an elk tailgate over live fire. Andrew makes chorizo-spiced elk meatballs with queso fundido and red chile salsa, then cooks hay-smoked elk chops with charred alliums and black garlic-juniper butter.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern shares a simple trick for getting the most out of bison tomahawk chops.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies working with live sea urchin and scallops by creating a showstopping seafood risotto.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders

The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates.

programme.desc: Stories can be told from a rain puddle or a pile of snow, but only a forensic meteorologist has the ability to look at these and help solve murders. "Storm of Suspicion" highlights crime and weather and how these two can be intertwined. Elements -- like dew drops or even the temperature -- can be the key to unlocking more clues to solve crimes. The cases that are featured are bone-chilling and almost unbelievable. In some cases, it is seen where a rain puddle can preserve DNA, or a snow pile can feature footprints. Dr. Elizabeth Austin, a forensic meteorologist who has worked on countless cases in which weather and crime go hand in hand plays a part in the series.
